helperReview.scope: Bounded GitHub transport and managed OTP sender contract; genuine Testing OTP sign-in and reload passed.

scope: Supported operator release security/resource review completed; not independent penetration testing, unlimited-scale certification, or full production operational readiness.

sensitiveBoundaryReview.managedRoutes: Existing Convex Auth routes retained; OTP contract verified. Google Workspace tenant acceptance remains Step 7 dependency.
sensitiveBoundaryReview.http: Authenticated bounded delivery callbacks, exact commit/run provenance, hashed product-event tokens and verified Stripe signatures; no auth tables or private keys returned publicly.
sensitiveBoundaryReview.rendering: Artifact execution stays in scripts-only opaque-origin sandbox with restrictive CSP; browser reports remain labeled client-reported. Chart styles use application configuration; no untrusted HTML rendering path found.
sensitiveBoundaryReview.compatibility: Existing public contracts preserved; Testing deploy reports backward-compatible.
